Uploads your latest content to your own WebDAV. Automatic sync only uploads — the cloud copy never overwrites this device.

Nextcloud: https://your-host/remote.php/dav/files/<user>/<folder>/\nSynology/NAS: http://192.168.1.5:5005/dav/<folder>/ (plain http is flagged as risky)\nThe URL must point to a directory and end with /; do not put the user name or password in it.
An app-specific password is recommended so it can be revoked on its own. It is stored in the app-private directory and is excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.
Trust and remember this certificate fingerprint

Sync timing: uploads happen only when content is saved (exit/back, going to the background, plus the automatic saves triggered by rotation or a dark-mode switch) — every save tries **immediately**, with no throttle at all. Whether a request is actually sent depends only on whether the content changed (if nothing changed, no request is sent). At most one upload runs at a time; when saves outpace the upload, later ones are merged into the run in progress. Only **failures** create a retry interval (1 s / 3 s inside the foreground window, then exponential backoff by the system fallback job, at most 5 times). Opening the app only checks whether anything changed locally since the last successful upload — if so, an orange dot lights up on the "Upload to cloud now" button, and nothing is uploaded. A progress notification is shown while syncing and removed the moment it ends — no background task is left behind.
